title: CaughtUp
paragraphs: As a former founding member and software engineer at CaughtUp, I helped build an Angular web app backed by Firebase.
I also contributed to a VT Hacks event-parser prototype that turned photos into calendar events. These projects reflect my past work; I am no longer involved with CaughtUp.

title: Spot-Block

title: Jitter Neural Network
paragraphs: Max Jitter is usually used for video processing. However, by researching the fundamentals of Neural Networks and sprinkling some Javascript I found a creative way to utilize the software to make a visual representation of a Neural Network.

title: Sentanal
paragraphs: A basic Sentiment Analysis project designed to provide insights towards the truthfullness of a news article based on word frequency.
As a team we compared the accuracy of two Naive Bayes Classifiers which we implemented utlizing two different Python libraries, TextBlob and NLTK.

title: Student Housing Guide
